Independent non-author acceptance receipt for awestruck-starchy-cowbird.

Evidence: the exact recorded comment-only guard and path-scoped diff check passed; byte-filtered non-comment projections match for all five files. The shebang, five ShellCheck directives, both refusal-marker lines, both executable scratch proof-marker paths, and all runtime $${...} Terraform escapes are byte-exact. Required prose escape examples remain present. Focused suites passed 38 + 68 tests; repository lint and commit-ticket verification passed. Changed paths are exactly the five declared paths; the worktree remains clean.

Independent block census: 29 maximal standalone-comment regions, 2,868 -> 1,167 whitespace-delimited words (1,701 removed). Every region is strictly shorter, accurate, and useful; no semantic-preservation or bloat-removal failure remains.
